Chapter 7191: Hidden Immortal

Chapter 7191: Hidden Immortal

“Rumble!” Genesis gained the powers of two worlds and channeled them into Heavencrush.

Despite emitting a blinding radiance, Heavencrush didn’t shoot out anything. A maelstrom formed and acted as a core.

The machine transformed into a strange metallic mirror, reflecting rays everywhere. These rays caused no harm but appeared to be outlining everything.

Once completed, the machine shot out a perfect image of the nine major worlds. This image began stacking on the real thing.

“He wants the living beings’ side!” Empress Hong Tian shouted.

“I’m done playing with you!” Li Baye shouted and swung the primordial tree, crushing Lightness Erasure and sending Heavenfall flying.

“Little Genesis, ready to die?” He intended to stop the process.

“Pop!” Suddenly, Octopus appeared and coiled its tentacles around the tree.

“Eat this!” He smashed his head against the octopus, crushing the dimensions.

Octopus was far stronger than Heavenfall and didn’t become injured. It wrapped its tentacles around Li Baye’s head, seemingly wringing it off.

“Foul and smelly thing!” Li Baye whirled his body, wanting to use it like a rod.

His body was the strongest weapon, agile enough to move despite having his head covered.

The two smashed into the deepest dimension. However, Octopus refused to let go.

Empress Hong Tian had to take action and attacked Genesis, using her Heaven Suppression Art.

“Bam!” Unfortunately, immortal flames appeared and turned into a pair of phoenix wings blocking her seal.

Beneath the wings was a gorgeous girl, more beautiful than anyone in existence. Particle feathers fell around her, pulsing in a magnificent manner.

“Hidden Immortal, Phoenix Queen.” Empress Hong Tian’s expression soured.

Others became confused since they didn’t connect the two beings together. Hidden Immortal was the most mysterious while Phoenix Queen was rumored to have died long ago.

“Such determination and strength, no wonder you were a favorite disciple. What a shame...” Hidden Immortal said, her voice was as alluring as her appearance.

She swung her wing and caused Hong Tian to vomit blood.

“Eternal Iron Heart!” The empress erupted with light before gathering them into her body. She became dimmed like an old jewel.
